scope: 通用广告与消费者保护（联邦竞争法 + 首都区法 + 旁遮普/信德省法）+ 小家电与 3C 数码的强制认证（PSQCA）与风扇能效标签（NEECA）+ 商品说明（货物买卖法）
date_policy: effective_date 取官方文本印明的生效/签署日。ICPA 1995、PSQCA Act 1996、SCPA 2014 的文本只写 come into force at once、未印具体日期，其 effective_date 取该法通过年度（1995/1996/2015）的 1 月 1 日作为占位下界，精确日未核到——报告中不得引用这三个具体日期。
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在「法条原文 + 页面原文」同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判「需要证明」；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 经营者在巴基斯坦不得实施欺骗性营销行为；判断以页面整体表述是否可能误导消费者为准，不要求证明实际有人被误导。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面快照（含时间戳）、同一表述在广告投放中的版本、可支持该表述的检测报告或第三方认证。
rules.penalty_or_note: 竞争法 s.38(2)(a)：可处不超过 7,500 万卢比或年度营业额 10% 的罚款（以委员会裁量为准）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No undertaking shall enter into deceptive marketing practices.
rules.notes: Competition Act 2010 适用范围为全巴基斯坦（s.1(2)），是本库中唯一同时覆盖全国线上线下的通用反误导条款。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 向消费者发布与价格、性质、生产方法或地点、性能、适用性或质量有关的虚假或误导信息（包括缺乏合理依据的信息）属欺骗性营销。
rules.evidence_needed: 价格历史与成交记录、原产地证明/提单、规格书与检测报告、能效测试报告；无法提供时只能写「页面未提供依据，需向商家核实」。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 s.38(2)(a)。条文含「lacking a reasonable basis」（缺乏合理依据），因此「无法证明」本身即可构成风险点。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: the distribution of false or misleading information to consumers, including the distribution of information lacking a reasonable basis, related to the price, character, method or place of production, properties, suitability for use, or quality of goods;
rules.notes: 本库最核心的单条规则：绝大多数页面夸大表述都可落在此条。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 广告中对商品作虚假或误导性比较属欺骗性营销；比较是否公平（基准、口径、可比型号）需结合语境判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 比较对象的型号与价格、比较口径（测试条件、时间、渠道）、同一页面是否披露比较基准。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: false or misleading comparison of goods in the process of advertising; or
rules.notes: 比较广告本身不当然构成问题；需判断基准是否真实、是否同代同规格。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 以欺诈方式使用他人商标、商号或产品标签/包装属欺骗性营销；页面使用他人品牌名指代兼容性时，须清楚区分「兼容」与「原厂」。
rules.evidence_needed: 商标授权文件、进货凭证、兼容性说明的位置与显著性。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: fraudulent use of another's trademark, firm name, or product labeling or packaging.
rules.notes: 配件类（滤网、刷头、充电器）高风险；「for Dyson」写法在部分市场被接受，但需与「原厂」明确区分。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 违反第二章（含 s.10 欺骗性营销）的，委员会可处不超过 7,500 万卢比或不超过年度营业额 10% 的罚款。
rules.evidence_needed: 如需评估敞口：营收口径、违规持续时间、是否配合调查。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限为上述二者之一，由委员会按情节裁量；本库只写上限，不代表必然处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: for a contravention of any provision of Chapter II of the Act, an amount not exceeding seventy-five million rupees or an amount not exceeding ten percent of the annual turnover of the undertaking, as may be decided in the circumstances of the case by the Commission; or
rules.notes: 报告只写「罚则上限」，不写「必然处罚」。

rules.law_name: Competition Act, 2010 竞争法 2010
rules.requirement: 对绝对化、排名、性能倍数、认证、环保与安全类表述，只能判「需要证明」：页面是否给出可核验的依据来源与口径。
rules.evidence_needed: 检测机构与报告编号、认证证书编号与发证机构、统计口径与样本、比较基准；「certified」须能指认具体认证体系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 无法提供依据时，该信息可能落入 s.10(2)(b) 的「lacking a reasonable basis」。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: including the distribution of information lacking a reasonable basis
rules.notes: 这一条把「夸大」与「定性」分开：报告只写「需要证明」，不判真假。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 在促销中虚假表示商品的等级、质量标准、数量、成色、成分、款式或型号，属不公平交易行为。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品实际规格与页面描述逐项对照、进货单据、型号铭牌照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区（s.1(2)）；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely representing that the goods or, as the case may be, services are of a particular standard, quality, quantity, grade, composition, style or mode;
rules.notes: 与旁遮普/信德 s.21(a) 同构；三地并行适用时以销售发生地为准。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 虚假表示商品获得主管机关/机构的赞助或批准，或具有其实际不具备的特定特性、性能、配件、用途或功效，属不公平交易行为。
rules.evidence_needed: 批准/认证文件与编号、发证机构、证书覆盖的型号是否与本 SKU 一致。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely representing that the goods or, as the case may be, services have sponsorship or approval of the competent agency or authority or possesses specified characteristics, performance, accessories, uses or benefits which such goods or services do not have;
rules.notes: 「CE / FCC / RoHS」等标志在巴基斯坦并非准入标志，页面以之暗示本地批准时风险更高。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 虚假表示商品符合本地或国际主管机关设定的标准，属不公平交易行为。
rules.evidence_needed: 标准编号与版本、检测报告、证书覆盖型号；仅有标志而无编号时需向商家索取。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely representing that the goods or services offered fulfil the prescribed standard fixed by local or international authorities;
rules.notes: 巴基斯坦本地强制标准为 PS 系列（PSQCA），国际标准（IEC/ISO）不能替代 PS 认证。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 就性能、规格、成分、功效或使用寿命向公众作出担保/保证，而该担保并非基于充分适当测试的，属不公平交易行为；本库只判「是否有测试依据」。
rules.evidence_needed: 保修条款文本（谁承担、覆盖范围、除外条款）、寿命/循环测试报告与测试标准。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: falsely giving to the public any warrantly or guarantee of the performance, specification, required ingredients, efficacy or length of life of a product or any goods that is not based on an adequate or proper tests thereof;
rules.notes: 官方 PDF 原文将 warranty 拼作 warrantly，引文照录未改。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 就商品当时的通常售价误导公众属不公平交易行为；划线价/折扣是否真实取决于该价格是否曾在合理期间实际成交。
rules.evidence_needed: 该 SKU 过去 30/60/90 天的实际成交价与促销排期、划线价的定义。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: misleading the public concerning the price at which a product or products or goods or services have been, or are ordinarily sold or provided;
rules.notes: 单凭页面无法判断划线价真伪，一律走人工复核。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 以特价招揽但并不打算按该价格供货的广告（诱饵广告）属不公平交易行为。
rules.evidence_needed: 该价格的库存与可售期间、活动规则、是否以缺货引导至其他 SKU。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；罚则见 s.9。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: advertising for the sale or supply at a bargain price of goods or services which are not intended to be offered for sale or supply at such price;
rules.notes: 需结合库存数据判断，页面本身只能作为触发线索。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 任何公司、商号或个人不得以法律未授权的方式为销售/出租商品或服务作广告，并因此给消费者造成金钱或其他损失。
rules.evidence_needed: 广告投放素材与渠道、消费者投诉/损失记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: ICPA 仅适用于伊斯兰堡首都区；s.9(2) 对违反 s.7 的广告行为另设刑责。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: no company, firm or person shall advertise in any manner not authorised by law for the sale or hiring of goods or services or any property, movable or immovable, or solicit deposits for repayment at higher rates of profits or interest and thereby causes loss to any consumer, whether financial or otherwise.
rules.notes: s.7 以「造成损失」为要件，单独页面表述通常不足以认定；作为背景条款收录。

rules.law_name: Islamabad Consumers Protection Act, 1995 伊斯兰堡消费者保护法 1995
rules.requirement: 通过纸媒、电子媒体或任何其他方式发布违反 s.7 的广告，可处不超过 2 年监禁或不超过 3 万卢比罚金，或二者并罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 如需评估敞口：广告发布渠道与时间、是否已产生消费者损失。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：2 年监禁 / 3 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。本库只写上限，不代表必然处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Whoever makes advertisement through print or electronic-media or by chalking on walls or in any other manner in contravention of section 7, he shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to two years, or with fine which may extend to thirty thousand rupees, or with both.
rules.notes: 金额为 1995 年数值，未随通胀调整；实际执法以法院裁量为准。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 旁遮普省法典官网 punjabcode.punjab.gov.pk / punjablaws.gov.pk 在本环境 TLS 不可达；引文取 FAOLEX（联合国粮农组织法律库）所存旁遮普法案英文全文 PDF，非省政府域名。
rules.requirement: 不得就商品的种类、标准、质量、等级、数量、成分、款式或型号作出虚假、欺骗或误导性表示。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面描述与实物规格/型号的逐项对照、进货凭证、铭牌照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.32(1)：可处不超过 2 年监禁或不超过 10 万卢比罚金，或并罚，另加损害赔偿。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall make a false, deceptive or misleading representation that– (a) the products are of a particular kind, standard, quality, grade, quantity, composition, style or model;
rules.notes: 旁遮普为巴基斯坦最大消费市场；本 PDF 为 FAOLEX 存档版本，2025 年修正案（Pb. Act LIV of 2025）是否改变本条未能核到。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 不得虚假表示商品或服务具有任何赞助、批准、背书、性能、特性、配件、用途或功效。
rules.evidence_needed: 背书/奖项/认证的原始文件、覆盖型号、有效期。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.32(1)：上限 2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (f) the products or services have any sponsorship, approval, endorsement, performance, characteristics, accessories, uses or benefits;
rules.notes: 「award winning」「lab tested」等属高频触发词，需索证。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 不得虚假表示商品为全新、翻新，或仅使用过特定期限；翻新/开箱机必须明确标注。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品状态说明、序列号与保修状态、翻新来源。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.32(1)：上限 2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (g) the products are new or reconditioned or have been in use for a particular period of time only;
rules.notes: 与 s.21(a) 常同时触发；翻新机未标注是本条最典型场景。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 不得就任何条件、担保、权利或救济的存在、排除或效果作虚假、欺骗或误导性表示。
rules.evidence_needed: 完整保修条款（主体、期限、除外、索赔流程）、退换政策页面。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.32(1)：上限 2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (j) concerns the existence, exclusion or effect of any condition, guarantee, right or remedy; and
rules.notes: 「official warranty」但未写明承担主体时，需人工判断是否构成误导。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 以特定价格广告供货的，须在合理期间、以合理数量按该价格实际可供货；否则构成诱饵广告。
rules.evidence_needed: 活动库存、可售时长、售罄后的处理方式（是否引导至其他 SKU）。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.32(1)：上限 2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Any person who has advertised products or services for supply at a specified price shall offer such products or services for supply at that price for a period that is, and in quantities that are reasonable having regard to the nature of the market in which the person carries on business and the nature of the advertisement.
rules.notes: 线上闪购常用「仅剩 X 件」，需与真实库存比对。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 卖家须在交易完成前，以购买点标识的方式清楚披露退换与退款政策。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品页/结算页是否在付款前展示退换货政策全文或可点击入口。
rules.penalty_or_note: PCPA s.23(1) 对违反 s.18/s.19 等可由主管部门罚款至 5 万卢比；s.20 的罚则路径见 s.32(1)。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Return and refund policy of a seller shall be disclosed to the buyer clearly before the transaction is completed by means of a sign at the point of purchase.
rules.notes: 条文写「购买点标识」，对纯线上交易的适用方式需律师确认，故列 human_review。

rules.law_name: Punjab Consumer Protection Act, 2005 旁遮普消费者保护法 2005
rules.official_url_note: 同上：FAOLEX 存档 PDF，省政府站点不可达。
rules.requirement: 违反 ss.4-8、11、13、14、16、18-22（含不公平交易行为与退换政策披露）的，可处不超过 2 年监禁或不超过 10 万卢比罚金，或并罚，并可另判损害赔偿。
rules.evidence_needed: 如需评估敞口：违规持续时间、是否已有消费者投诉。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。只写上限，不代表必然处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where a manufacturer fails to perform or in any way infringes the liabilities provided in sections 4 to 8, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18 to 22, he shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to two years or with fine which may extend to hundred thousand rupees or with both in addition to damages or compensation as may be determined by the court.
rules.notes: 2025 年修正案是否提高罚金未核到。

rules.law_name: Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014 信德消费者保护法 2014
rules.requirement: 不得就商品的种类、标准、质量、等级、数量、成分、款式或型号作出虚假、欺骗或误导性表示。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面描述与实物规格的逐项对照、进货凭证。
rules.penalty_or_note: SCPA s.33(1)：可处不超过 2 年监禁或不超过 10 万卢比罚金，或并罚，另加损害赔偿。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall make a false, deceptive or misleading representation that--- a) the products are of a particular kind, standard, quality, grade, quantity, composition, style or model;
rules.notes: 卡拉奇为巴基斯坦最大港口与电商消费城市；信德法案结构与旁遮普 s.21 基本一致。

rules.law_name: Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014 信德消费者保护法 2014
rules.requirement: 违反 ss.4-8、11、13、14、16、18-22（含 s.21 误导性表示）的，可处不超过 2 年监禁或不超过 10 万卢比罚金，或并罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 如需评估敞口：违规持续时间、消费者投诉记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 上限：2 年监禁 / 10 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。只写上限。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where a manufacturer fails to perform or in any way infringes the liabilities provide in sections 4 to 8, 11, 13, 14, 16, 18 to 22, he shall be punished with imprisonment which may extend to two years or with fine which may extend to hundred thousand rupees or with both in addition to damages or compensation as may be determined by the Court.
rules.notes: 官方 PDF 原文将 provided 拼作 provide，引文照录。

rules.law_name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 巴基斯坦标准与质量控制局法 1996
rules.requirement: 未取得该法下的许可或证书，不得在商品、工艺、专利名称、商标或外观设计上使用 PSQCA 的标志（PS Mark / 符合性标志 / 安全标志）。
rules.evidence_needed: CM Licence 编号与持证主体、证书覆盖的产品型号；页面上出现 PS 标志即应索证。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.20：违反 ss.10-12 可处不超过 1 年监禁或不少于 3 万卢比罚金，或并罚，并可没收相关财产。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall use, in relation to any article, product or process or in the title of any patent or in any trade marks or design the Authority marks except under a license or certificate issued under this Act.
rules.notes: 「未经许可使用标志」是可从页面直接观察的规则级问题；「是否已认证」不可从页面反推。

rules.law_name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 巴基斯坦标准与质量控制局法 1996
rules.requirement: 未经该局事先许可，不得使用与该局名称近似的名称，或在商品/工艺上使用含「Pakistan standard」「Pakistan standard specification」字样或其缩写的标志。
rules.evidence_needed: 许可文件；页面是否把「符合 PS 标准」写成「已获 PS 认证」。
rules.penalty_or_note: s.20：上限 1 年监禁 / 不少于 3 万卢比罚金（或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person shall without the previous permission of the Authority and subject to such conditions as may be prescribed, use—
rules.notes: 引文为 s.11 引导句，限定对象见 (a)(b) 两款。

rules.law_name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 巴基斯坦标准与质量控制局法 1996
rules.requirement: 联邦政府可经官方公报公告，自指定日期起禁止不符合巴基斯坦标准的特定商品的制造、储存与销售；落入公告清单的商品须先取得合规认证方可销售。
rules.evidence_needed: 该 SKU 是否在最新 SRO 强制清单内、对应 PS 标准编号、CM Licence。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.14 公告的，按 s.22 处罚（不超过 1 年监禁或不少于 5 万卢比罚金，或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Federal Government may, in consultation with the Authority and by notification in the official Gazette, prohibit, with effect from such date as may be specified in the notification, the manufacture, storage and sale of any article specified therein which does not conform to the Pakistan standard.
rules.notes: 本条是「强制认证」的法律授权条款；具体品类见 s.14 公告与 PSQCA 强制清单。

rules.law_name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 巴基斯坦标准与质量控制局法 1996
rules.requirement: 联邦政府可公告要求符合特定巴基斯坦标准的商品加施指定标志；被列入公告的商品，销售包装/机身上应可见该标志。
rules.evidence_needed: 实物或包装照片、CM Licence 编号、标志是否为本 SKU 型号所覆盖。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反按 s.22 处罚（不超过 1 年监禁或不少于 5 万卢比罚金，或并罚）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, require any article which conforms to a particular Pakistan standard to be marked with such distinctive mark as may be specified in the notification.
rules.notes: 页面未展示标志只能写「页面未展示，需向商家核实」，不得推断「未认证」。

rules.law_name: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority Act, 1996 巴基斯坦标准与质量控制局法 1996
rules.requirement: 违反该法、其规则或依 s.14 发布的公告（含制造、储存、销售不符合巴基斯坦标准的商品）的，可处不超过 1 年监禁或不少于 5 万卢比罚金，或并罚。
rules.evidence_needed: 如需评估敞口：涉及型号数量、库存与销售额。
rules.penalty_or_note: 注意 s.22 为「不少于」5 万卢比的下限罚金，与其他条款的「上限」写法不同。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Whoever contravenes any of the provisions of this Act or any rule made or notification issued thereunder, including a notification issued under Section 14, prohibiting, manufacture, storage or sale of an article not conforming to the Pakistan Standard shall, if no other penalty is elsewhere provided under this Act, be punishable with imprisonment of either description for a term which may extend to one year, or with fine which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees, or with both.
rules.notes: 罚金起点而非上限，报告中应写明「不少于」。

rules.law_name: S.R.O. 46(KE)/2020（依 PSQCA Act 1996 s.14 发布）
rules.requirement: 自 2020-12-31 起，附表第 (2) 栏所列商品若不符合巴基斯坦标准，禁止制造、储存与销售；符合标准的须加施该局标准标志。
rules.evidence_needed: 该 SKU 是否在附表内、对应 PS 标准、CM Licence 与标志照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反公告的按 PSQCA Act s.22 处罚（不少于 5 万卢比罚金 / 不超过 1 年监禁）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (a) prohibit, with effect from the 31st day of December, 2020, manufacture, keeping in stock and the sale of the articles specified in column (2) of the Schedule below which do not conform to the Pakistan Standards; and
rules.notes: 官方 PDF 为扫描件（CamScanner），引文经 300dpi 图像逐字核对；附表为竖排表格，本次未逐行转录。

rules.law_name: PSQCA 强制认证商品清单（List of Compulsory Item to meet Pakistan Standards）
rules.article: 清单条目（Electric irons / Household micro wave ovens / Comfort Fans / Self-Ballasted LED Lamps / Plugs and socket-outlets）
rules.requirement: 该局公布的强制清单列有家用电器与电器附件（如电熨斗 PS:185、家用微波炉 PS:5254、舒适风扇 PS:1、自镇流 LED 灯 PS:5252、插头插座 PS IEC 60884-1），列入商品需取得 CM 许可并使用 PS 标志后方可销售/进口。
rules.evidence_needed: 清单条目与该 SKU 的对应关系、CM Licence 编号、进口时的 PSQCA 清关检验记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 清单本身为监管机关指引，法律效力来自 s.14 公告；具体 SRO 编号需逐项核对。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Electric irons for household or similar use.
rules.notes: 清单页为 2026-11-17 抓取的 HTML；条目与 SRO 的对应关系只核到 s.14 层面，逐条 SRO 编号未核。

rules.law_name: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation (Pakistan Energy Labels for Fans) Regulations, 2023（S.R.O. 411(I)/2024）
rules.requirement: 任何人、制造商或进口商不得销售或采购不符合最低能效标准（MEPS）与「能效」定义的风扇；风扇类商品须先取得巴基斯坦能源标签。
rules.evidence_needed: 型号注册号与标签授权、MEPS 测试报告（认可实验室）、标签贴附照片。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反可被取消注册、责令下架全部库存，并由董事会依附表 V 决定罚款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: No person, manufacturer or importer shall sell or purchase any fan which is not energy efficient and not compliant to MEPS.
rules.notes: 「seller」定义明确包含「through some online process」（reg. 2(1)(xvii)），线上销售同样适用。

rules.law_name: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation (Pakistan Energy Labels for Fans) Regulations, 2023（S.R.O. 411(I)/2024）
rules.requirement: 为确保市场只售高能效风扇，风扇须带有巴基斯坦能源标签（含星级与注册信息）。
rules.evidence_needed: 标签实物/图片、标签上的注册号与型号是否与页面一致、二维码可否验证。
rules.penalty_or_note: 同 reg. 3(1) 的后果（取消注册、下架、罚款）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: In order to ensure that only energy efficient fans are sold in the market, these fans shall bear Pakistan energy label for fan.
rules.notes: 标签样式见该条例附表 IV，含防伪二维码（reg. 5(2)）。

rules.law_name: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation (Pakistan Energy Labels for Fans) Regulations, 2023（S.R.O. 411(I)/2024）
rules.requirement: 申请人须对标签信息及任何公开的「星级/能效等级与质量」声称的真实性负全责，且只能用于已批准型号。
rules.evidence_needed: 注册型号清单、对应星级、测试报告；同一页面其他型号是否借用该标签。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不实声称可导致注册取消与罚款（reg. 7(7)、reg. 8(5)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: The applicant shall be solely responsible for ensuring the accuracy of the information displayed on the label or any public claim for label level and quality of product and use of label only for approved product's model.
rules.notes: 「public claim」覆盖网页文案，是本库中少数明确指向线上宣传的条文。

rules.law_name: Sale of Goods Act, 1930 货物买卖法 1930
rules.requirement: 凭说明成立的买卖，货物须与说明相符；说明与实物不符时，即使样品相符亦不满足该默示条件。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面规格表与实物铭牌/包装标注的逐项对照。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事后果：买方可主张违约救济（退换、损害赔偿），非行政处罚。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where there is a contract for the sale of goods by description, there is an implied condition that the goods shall correspond with the description ; and, if the sale is by sample as well as by description it is not sufficient that the bulk of the goods corresponds with the sample if the goods do not also correspond with the description.
rules.notes: 规格数字（容量/功率/电池容量）是最常见的「说明不符」来源。

rules.law_name: Sale of Goods Act, 1930 货物买卖法 1930
rules.requirement: 买方明示或默示告知特定用途并依赖卖方技能判断时，货物须合理适合该用途；是否构成依赖需结合页面表述与交易过程判断。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面用途表述、商品实际适用条件（电压、插头型式、环境）、售前沟通记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事后果：违约救济；本库只用于提示「用途声称需有依据」。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: Where the buyer, expressly or by implication, makes known to the seller the particular purpose for which the goods are required, so as to show that the buyer relies on the seller’s skill or judgment, and the goods are of a description which it is in the course of the seller’s business to supply (whether he is the manufacturer of producer or not), there is an implied condition that the goods shall be reasonably fit for such purpose :
rules.notes: 巴基斯坦电压 220-240V、50Hz、D/G 型插头；页面标 110V 或美规插头却称「for Pakistan」时风险显著。
